The biggest bodies are colliding in Week 7 and Week 8 of the 2026-27 NHL season. Relive the hardest checks, glass-rattling collisions and massive open-ice hits from around the League.
Gavin McKenna gets blasted by Yakov Trenin, Tyler Myers steamrolls Cole Perfetti, Jamie Benn delivers a bone-rattling check, Kaedan Korczak sends Jimmy Snuggerud head over heels into the Penguins bench and Connor Murphy throws his weight around against Vegas stars Jack Eichel and Mark Stone.
Turn it up and FEEL THE HIT.
